videos.title: Copy Cat Tutorials — Rebuilding Glowing Ribbons with 2D Effects
videos.summary: A "copycat" walkthrough recreating a glowing, squeezed-ribbon animation found on Reddit, built almost entirely from 2D line/point operators plus a post-processing chain (blur, glow, color remap). The transcript degrades into repeated ASR noise after roughly 36:40; all real content is in the first ~37 minutes.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#011 - Combining Point Buffers
videos.summary: A short tip showing that each point operator emits its own GPU point buffer, and how keeping the original and modified buffers around lets you wire them together — pairing positions to draw lines, then scattering meshes across the same points.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-09-08 — Roadmap features, operator style guide, creating a new op
videos.summary: A long, mostly-unstructured roadmap meet-up: the first half is feature-voting discussion (FFmpeg playback, output manager, project namespaces, asset window), and the back half turns into a live patching session — a height-map/SDF scene rebuilt from a reference clip, then a hands-on tutorial building a new field-color operator and a deterministic-random-index operator.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-06-29 — Particles Deep Dive
videos.summary: A four-hour community meetup centered on the particle system: why transparent particles get black outlines and how depth sorting works, the ring-buffer internals of [ParticleSystem] and [FilterPoints], particle-trail and branching tricks, plus demos of the upcoming 4.2 help window, snapshots for live performance, MIDI/IO recording, and the new FFmpeg video playback.

videos.title: "TiXL Update: Drawing with OSC Input"
videos.summary: How to drive live visuals from a phone or tablet over OSC: [OscInput] auto-detects the address of any control you touch (the built-in teach mode), multiple inputs on the same port share one connection for free, and its float output can be split into X/Y/pressure to paint feedback trails whose color and line breaks follow the incoming pressure. A practical walkthrough of wiring a TouchOSC-style device into a generative drawing patch.

videos.title: TiXL for Beginners Meetup #1 — Real-Time Fundamentals & Building a Blender Donut
videos.summary: A beginners meet-up that first explains TiXL's real-time CPU/GPU model and the three performance bottlenecks (poly count, fill-rate/overdraw, memory), then builds a "Blender donut" from scratch — a ray-marched torus with materials, a faked floor shadow, point lights, an image-based environment, color grading, and scattered sprinkles — closing with a workflow method for reproducing a reference image.

videos.title: Using the new Shader Graph (Deep Dive)
videos.summary: A guided tour of TiXL's new SDF/field shader-graph system: the four operator categories (generators, space, adjust, combine), how ray-marching renders fields, performance and aliasing trade-offs, and using fields to drive particle forces and point selection.

videos.title: Let's build a logo animation from scratch
videos.summary: Silent screen-capture tutorial building a logo animation from scratch — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#009 - Animating String Parts
videos.summary: A short tip-of-the-day walkthrough showing how to split a text into lines/words/characters and step through the fragments to animate text, then pointing to a simpler random-string shortcut.

videos.title: Using Shader Graph and Particles in the Making of "Ashborn"
videos.summary: A scripted making-of walking through the TiXL "Ashborn" demo: keyframing every piano note, SDF-driven particle forces, a height-map landscape field, and a late refactor of tangled graph connections into context variables. Equal parts creative-process diary and operator tour of the shader-graph + particle setup.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#019 - Color Grading
videos.summary: A five-minute introduction to color grading in Tooll, centered on the lift/gamma/gain controls of the ColorGrade operator, reading the WaveForm operator's scope, and comparing before/after with CompareImages.

videos.title: TiXL for Beginners Meetup #2 — Evaluation Context, Resolution & Blending
videos.summary: An unstructured beginner webinar walking through TiXL's evaluation context: how time (in musical bars) and the "magic" 0,0 resolution flow backwards from the output, how image operators chain and blend, HDR colours, the gain/bias mapping curve, and a closing live experiment building a particle "black hole".

videos.title: Combining SelectFaces with ScatterMeshFace effects
videos.summary: Silent demo combining face selection with mesh-face scattering — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-01-26 / Assets, Mediapipe and SkillQuest
videos.summary: A long live meet-up covering the new asset-library/path overhaul, a performance-monitor walkthrough and GPU benchmarking, an end-to-end MediaPipe hand-tracking particle build, authoring SkillQuest tutorials, and community demos (Assimp import, AI shader generation, VAT instancing).

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#016 - Adjusting Soundtrack and BPM-Rate
videos.summary: A tip walkthrough explaining why all time in Tooll runs in bars rather than seconds, how to add a soundtrack to a project and dial in its BPM rate so procedural animation stays synced.

videos.title: Tooll V3.9 / New Features
videos.summary: Release-notes walkthrough of Tooll 3.9: expanded operator/parameter docs, faster video+audio export, glTF scene loading, Ableton Link sync, colored/stretchable points, the combined bias-and-gain control, new effects, and particle-system updates.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-11-03 / Asset Lib and SDF fun
videos.summary: A wide-ranging community meet-up: a "Draw Lines Alt" walkthrough, three random-operator prompt challenges, a deep dive into the new asset browser, a long camera/transform-matrix exploration driven by an OSC phone, and pitches for a parameter-level snapshot/state-machine system and SDF spatial-displacement features.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#020 - Time Clips
videos.summary: A walkthrough of TimeClips: how clips on the timeline gate which parts of a graph get evaluated per scene, and how dragging or stretching a clip remaps the time fed into its sub-graph, with the colour cues (orange/red) that signal time remapping and time-scaling.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-08-24 — SDF Text Blending, Particles & Anaglyph
videos.summary: A four-and-a-half-hour community session that experiments with blending text-based SDFs, walks through the new player-export and shader-caching improvements, builds a text-outline particle emitter with lifetime attribute mapping, dissects an anaglyph stereo camera setup (including live-coding a camera-reference input for [CamPosition]), creates [RemapVec3] on the spot, and presents the upcoming physical-space output-management board.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#021 - Hacking the render Time
videos.summary: A short tip on overriding the time that drives an animation: wrap a rendered texture in a command-time operator and feed it a custom time signal (a sine, a remapped random, a beat) to scrub, loop, or jump regions of a timeline non-linearly.

videos.title: Depth based color grading (Work in progress)
videos.summary: Silent work-in-progress demo of depth-based color grading — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: Meet-up — Demo Timing, Sine Waves from Line Points, the Custom Point Shader & Rebuilding a Helix
videos.summary: A ~3.7h Q&A meet-up covering deterministic demo construction (time clips, preloading via set-time, smooth procedural timing), several ways to turn a line of points into a sine wave, the custom point shader and its SDF field input, point alpha/Z-sorting trade-offs, and a long live rebuild of a twisted-helix reference scene.

videos.title: "Tooll 3 Tip#008 - Procedural Camera Animations"
videos.summary: A short tip walking through the parameters of the RandomCamera operator for procedural camera moves, plus how to drive its seed and shake inputs from a beat counter and noise.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#007 - Animating the Steps effect
videos.summary: A short scripted tip showing how the [Steps] image effect posterizes a gradient into bands, then animating it by wiring counters and an LFO into its offset, gradient rotation, and highlight color.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-07-27 — Output Management, Projection Mapping & Custom Point Shaders
videos.summary: A community meetup where the maintainer previews the new output-management/projection-mapping system for 4.3 (content→surface→output abstraction, calibration, setups), answers point-color questions with deep [CustomPointShader] live-coding, extends [BlendPoints] on stream, and prototypes a drone-show pipeline with particle forces.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#012 - Noisy Point Trails
videos.summary: A short tip showing how to feed animated, noise-displaced points into a cyclic trail buffer to draw streaking trails, then layer extra noise and fog on the result.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-08-10 — Drone Show Choreography, Video Pipeline & Audio Graph
videos.summary: A five-and-a-half-hour community meetup that opens with reaction-diffusion feedback experiments, previews the upcoming 4.3 features (asset link files, the node-based audio graph, video editing timeline, FFmpeg playback and HAP export, texture-array frame history), and ends in a long collaborative session building a 100-drone show in TiXL with speed/collision validation and a DDS texture export into Blender.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#003 - Resolution Magic
videos.summary: A short tip explaining how an image operator's resolution is resolved: the "magic" 0×0 default pulls resolution from an incoming texture if present, otherwise from the output window, and how -1 or an explicit size overrides that.

videos.title: TiXL Tip#23 - Get Positions in Screen Space
videos.summary: A tip-of-the-day walkthrough of the new [GetScreenPos] operator (TiXL 4.0.2), which converts a world-space locator into a 2D screen-space coordinate so a label or billboard can be pinned over a point in a post-processed 3D scene.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-07-13 — Custom Shaders, Custom Draw Mesh & 4.2 Release
videos.summary: A nearly four-hour community meetup centered on TiXL's custom shader family: fixing the raymarch perspective-shift and [SortPoints] bugs, an extended live exploration of the new custom draw mesh operator (fields, point attributes, lights, image inputs), plus the 4.2 release, the backup/recovery system, and a roadmap discussion covering glTF character animation, reroute nodes, and a future shader graph.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-02-09 / Part 2 (Building a complex shader op)
videos.summary: A long live coding session that wraps a prototype "projected volumetric light" graph into the new [ProjectLight] post-effect operator: wiring camera references, a switchable projector, a shadow render pass, packing parameters into a constant buffer, moving inline shader code into an `.hlsl` asset file, and finishing with grouping, a sample scene, and thumbnails.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#005 - Snapping Keyframes
videos.summary: A short tip on snapping keyframes precisely in the timeline: pinning parameters, switching the ruler from seconds to bars/beats/ticks, and using ALT to scale and insert keyframes onto snap targets.

videos.title: Depth based color grading (Work in progress)
videos.summary: Silent work-in-progress demo of depth-based color grading — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#018 - Saving Screenshots
videos.summary: A short tip showing the Save Screenshot button, which writes the current output frame at full resolution to the `.t3/screenshots` folder.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#015 - Draw Quads with Variations
videos.summary: A short tip showing how the W (fourth) point attribute can drive per-quad variation, and how [SelectPoints] writes a spatial selection back into W to mask large point clouds interactively.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#002 - Raster Effects
videos.summary: A short tip walking through the versatile Raster operator: its presets and knobs, then driving it from an input texture and stacking offset copies into a CMYK-style halftone print effect.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup — Per-Parameter Snapshots, FFmpeg Video/Audio/Data Clips, and DMX Lighting
videos.summary: A long developer meet-up walking through the new per-parameter snapshot control, the FFmpeg-based video/audio/MIDI-recording clip system, guided feature tests, and a deep dive into driving DMX/Artnet moving-head lights from points.

videos.title: "Hands-On 002: Creating a 3D Animated Brick Ocean"
videos.summary: A hands-on build of a "brick ocean" scene: a 100×100 grid of beveled-cube bricks displaced by noise into a rolling ocean, plus a glowing cube driven by a shared locator, finished with image-based lighting and a post-processing stack (SSAO, depth of field, color grade, glow, chromatic aberration).

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#017 - Cloning vs. Instancing Meshes
videos.summary: A short tip contrasting two ways to multiply a mesh across scattered points: baking copies into one large mesh (cloning) versus drawing the same mesh repeatedly per point (instancing), and the trade-offs in memory, performance, and what you can still modify afterward.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-08-25 — Timeline, PBR-rendering, particles, fields and the future of outputs
videos.summary: A long maintainer-led meet-up walking the last two weeks of commits: timeline/time-clip editing, beat-locking, the unified PBR rendering path, field-driven point selection, and an extended brainstorm on a future multi-output / projection-mapping system.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#013 - Drive Animations with Audio Reactions
videos.summary: A short tip showing how to feed external audio into the graph and use [AudioReaction] to drive a particle scene — clearing the background and re-seeding randomness on each beat, and steering camera and noise with the level output.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#22 - Lost in Feedback
videos.summary: A deep walkthrough of the AdvancedFeedback effect: how its displace-along-a-slope feedback loop works internally, and a guided tour of nearly every parameter (twist, displacement, sample distance, shade, blur, color shifts, amplified edges, limit brights) and how to drive them for smoke-, water- and reaction-diffusion-like looks.

videos.title: "TiXL Meetup 2026-01-26 / Part 2: SkillQuest"
videos.summary: Improvised newcomer intro on a meet-up stream: the host walks a graphic designer through building a procedural logo animation from a loaded image — image effects, gradient sampling, oscillator-driven parameters, key/feedback, directional blur, and gradient masks — while wrestling with streaming-induced slowdowns.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-09-22 / Particle Effects, Groups operators, TimeClips, Time Scaling, Audio Sync
videos.summary: A live meet-up that rebuilds a viewer's water/particle scene from scratch, then dives deep into wrapping graphs into operators, time clips and time-remapping, the pull-based evaluation model, an SDF-driven fog scene with color grading, particle factor remapping, and a long open design discussion about multi-channel audio routing.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#014 - Complexity with the Invert Blend Mode
videos.summary: A short tip showing how the Invert blend mode turns a plain field of overlapping quads into rich, animated abstract patterns, layering point generators, transforms, and an LFO to drive the complexity.

videos.title: TiXL v4.0 — All New Features and Updates
videos.summary: The v4.0 release walkthrough: the new install/export flow and project-data locations, a pass of graph/timeline UI improvements, and a long tour of new and updated shader-graph, point, particle, mesh, animation, I/O, and color operators.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-01-12 / Fun with F1 & F2
videos.summary: A long community meet-up walking through recently merged pull requests (delete-symbol, MSDF font generator, camera-distance point sorting, consistent gradients, render-to-file rework) and live-patching demos of new operators (FastBlur, RemoveStaticBackground, KeepInTextureArray, beat-tapping audio sync); the back third drifts into projection-mapping, licensing, and hardware chatter.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-02-23 / Building complex scenes
videos.summary: A long, unstructured meet-up: a warm-up procedural-text background, a guest walkthrough of the new GPU FABRIK IK operator, a from-scratch "Matrix tentacle monster" using SDF ray-marched leg targets, and a rebuild of an Instagram generative constellation with custom point shaders. Threaded throughout are a stale dirty-flag/caching bug, the new thumbnail-everywhere browsing system, and bias-and-gain as a recurring shaping trick.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-12-01 / Fun with F1 & F2
videos.summary: A 3.5-hour meet-up that opens with a naming/precision discussion and a tour of the new SkillQuest tutorial system, then spends most of its length on a deep, example-driven explanation of the per-point F1/F2 spare attributes — how operators write and consume them — and ends with a live code-edit adding F1/F2 and a strength factor to an operator, plus experiments with the new normal-buffer output.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-06-01 / New Timeline, Spline Editor, Audio Clips & AI Coding
videos.summary: A wide-ranging meetup walking through the rewritten timeline and spline curve editor, the new alpha-version workflow with guided feature tests, multi-track audio and IO-recording clips, and live demos of trigger-keyframe workarounds, Switch/Pick bypassing, custom shaders, and procedural city geometry with SDF fields.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-10-06 — Particle System Deep Dive
videos.summary: A near-exhaustive walk through the particle system: emit/lifetime/orientation parameters, then every force operator with built-from-scratch examples, followed by a long live session rebuilding a Houdini line-grid demo with SDFs, point pairing, and per-strand isolation.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-02-09 / Part 1 (Patching)
videos.summary: A casual patching meet-up that opens by improvising a glowing title effect with [DirectionalBlur], then turns into a live walkthrough of the new thumbnail-manager system (texture atlas, per-symbol curated thumbnails) and a hot-reload coding session inside the MagGraph node-drawing code to make nodes show a stored thumbnail when they have no live texture.

videos.title: HandsOn 001 — Build an Abstract 3D Animation in ~12 Minutes
videos.summary: A fast, scripted hands-on build of an abstract glowing 3D scene: a torus-studded sphere with scattered point clouds, two colored point lights, an orbiting camera, and a full post-processing stack (depth of field, glow, color grade, grain, chromatic distortion).

videos.title: Combining Color Grading with Preset Blending
videos.summary: Silent demo combining color grading with preset blending — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: "Tooll 3 Tip#010 - Using points to draw Meshes"
videos.summary: Opening tip in a points series: explains the eight-value point structure (position, weight W, quaternion orientation), pushes a point list to a GPU buffer, then instances a mesh onto every point and shows how W and randomization drive the result.

videos.title: SoftTransformPoint effect
videos.summary: Silent demo clip of the SoftTransformPoints effect — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-03-23 — Mesh-Volume Collision, Moving Points & SDF Lighting
videos.summary: A long, hands-on meet-up built around the new MeshVolumeForce particle collider and the DrawMovingPoints stretch-render, followed by Q&A on faking screen lighting, an SDF laser-reflection toy, an audio-reactive SDF cityscape walkthrough, and a closing dive into quaternion blending pitfalls and procedural camera paths.

videos.title: Tooll V3.6 / Overview and New Features
videos.summary: Release walkthrough of Tooll 3.6: color and gradient workflow improvements, dope-sheet auto-pin, smarter symbol-browser relevancy and multi-connection, the image-effect shader template, per-project playback/audio settings, and two new operators (RenderWithMotionBlur and DrawBillboards) plus the custom point shader.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2025-12-15 / BubbleZoom and other experiments
videos.summary: A long, exploratory TiXL meet-up: reworking the BubbleZoom magnifier parameters, reviewing the PR workflow, fixing an old feedback logo, dissecting the shadow render pipeline, debugging back-face shading and equirectangular point rendering, walking through custom-shader authoring with RenderDoc, and a deep live experiment building an "infinite zoom" scene-transition.

videos.title: Use Blender to prepare OBJ models for Tooll3
videos.summary: Silent walkthrough of preparing OBJ models in Blender for import — no narration, so no operator mentions could be transcribed.

videos.title: TiXL Meetup 2026-03-09 — Single-Line Number Fonts, Beat-Sync Tapping and a Keyframe-Constant Regression Hunt
videos.summary: A long, exploratory meet-up: walking through the finicky single-line-number-font setup (LineTextPoints + a field-driven custom point shader), demoing beat-sync tapping and the "space evenly" keyframe tool, adding field inputs to the custom point shader, and a drawn-out hunt for a regression where constant-interpolation keyframes stopped updating on scrub.

videos.title: Tooll 3 Tip#004 - The Rings Effect
videos.summary: A short tip tour of the [Rings] operator, walking every parameter that shapes its concentric-ring pattern and pointing out which ones reward animation.
